name: Arize Phoenix
summary: Phoenix is Arize AI's open-source tool for tracing and evaluating LLM applications and agents. It is built on OpenTelemetry and the OpenInference instrumentation conventions, and adds LLM-based and code evaluators, datasets and experiments, and a prompt playground. It runs locally, in Docker or on Kubernetes at no cost; Arize AX is the company's separate managed enterprise platform.
watchOut: ELv2 forbids offering it as a hosted service
Managed enterprise features live in the separate Arize AX product
